cards.title: Box
cards.creator: Tiffany Glass & Decorating Company
cards.extract: By 1900 Tiffany had expanded his empire by increasing the firm’s production of “fancy goods,” including inkstands, candlesticks, clocks, small boxes, desk sets, tea screens, and other functional objects. Along with the array of artistic glass designs from his factory in Corona, Queens, works in ceramic, bronze, other metals, and even jewelry abounded. These smaller, more affordable luxury items were designed with as much thought to artistry as the great stained glass windows and lamps through which the firm enjoyed unrivaled success.

cards.title: nendo on bringing the river-inspired design of france’s TGV INOUI into motion
cards.extract: seven years of development turned an idea about the movement of water into a detailed design language, from the train’s exterior patterns to its passenger spaces and everyday fittings. cards.title: Open Call: "The Bath in the Lake"
cards.extract: THE BATH IN THE LAKE competition is a Madeby initiative created to recognise architectural proposals that explore the relationship between landscape, water and architecture by taking the bathroom out of its usual setting and placing it in a natural environment. The call invites participants to reflect on the idea of bathing, the space that contains it and the way it is inhabited, treating the bathroom as an object…
